re_line: RE: Kim's Dandong trip · Fifth Plenum opens · US-China investment spat · Taiwan Restoration Day · stock rout
morning_memo: Kim Jong Un made a surprise day trip to Dandong Saturday, his first China visit in over a year, meeting Politburo Standing Committee member Wang Huning rather than Xi Jinping.
China's Fifth Plenum opens in Beijing Monday after Anhui, Henan, Shanxi and Xinjiang completed provincial leadership reshuffles over the past week.
Beijing's Commerce Ministry protested a new US Treasury proposal expanding outbound-investment restrictions, calling it 'a typical case of overstretching the concept of national security.'

key_stat.label: Wiped from Chinese equities in an earnings-driven stock rout
key_stat.context: Bloomberg ties the decline to deteriorating corporate profits rather than a broad risk-off move, even as the Hang Seng fell 4.03% and the Shanghai Composite slipped 1.08% on Oct 23.

prc_government.document: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布新版对外投资限制拟议规则答记者问
prc_government.detail: MOFCOM said it 'firmly opposes' a new US Treasury rule adding biotechnology to restricted outbound-investment sectors and giving Treasury authority to designate further industries.

prc_government.action: Li Qiang chairs State Council executive meeting on population and economic-social development
prc_government.detail: The meeting studied coordinating population trends with economic and social development and reviewed implementation of a national services-sector conference deployment.

prc_government.action: PBOC rolls over CNY700bn MLF, a CNY200bn net drain
prc_government.document: 2026年10月中期借贷便利招标公告
prc_government.detail: The central bank will conduct CNY700 billion in one-year MLF operations on Oct 26 against CNY900 billion maturing, a net drain versus September's CNY200 billion net add, as it studies shifting its primary policy-rate anchor to the overnight repo rate.

npc_politburo.body: CCP Central Inspection Work Leading Group
npc_politburo.action: 20th CC seventh round of inspections completes feedback to 36 central bodies
npc_politburo.detail: 15 central inspection teams delivered one-on-one feedback to 36 central party and state organs; Liu Jinguo, deputy head of the Central Inspection Work Leading Group, said agencies must track rectification and punish perfunctory responses.

npc_politburo.action: Anhui, Henan, Shanxi, Xinjiang install new standing committees ahead of Fifth Plenum
npc_politburo.detail: The four provinces wrapped up party congresses and named new five-year standing committees in the week before the Fifth Plenum of the 20th Central Committee convenes Monday in Beijing.

calendar_watch.headline: Fifth Plenum of the 20th Central Committee opens in Beijing
calendar_watch.detail: Follows a week of provincial leadership reshuffles; expected to finalize 15th Five-Year Plan recommendations ahead of the 21st Party Congress in 2027.

calendar_watch.headline: US midterm elections
calendar_watch.detail: Control of Congress at stake; Rep. Ami Bera said he will intensify pressure on the administration over a pending Taiwan arms sale if Democrats retake the House.

calendar_watch.headline: Busan-deal one-year suspensions approach lapse
calendar_watch.detail: The BIS Affiliates Rule suspension and China's October 2025 rare-earth export-control suspension are both due to expire around this date unless extended.

calendar_watch.headline: APEC Economic Leaders' Meeting opens in Shenzhen
calendar_watch.detail: China hosts; Trump attendance and any Trump-Xi meeting remain unconfirmed.

calendar_watch.headline: Taiwan nine-in-one local elections
calendar_watch.detail: Voters elect 22 mayors and magistrates and roughly 11,000 local offices in a mid-term test of the Lai administration.

overnight_items.headline: Independent economist Ren Zeping's WeChat account banned for 'violations'
overnight_items.body_text: Ren Zeping's widely followed 'Zeping Macro' WeChat account was banned for unspecified violations, Chinese media reported Saturday, after posting commentaries as recently as Oct. 23. His video account remains active.

overnight_items.headline: Tropical Storm Champi weakens after battering Taiwan, Japan's southern islands
overnight_items.body_text: Typhoon Champi, downgraded to a tropical storm with winds near 102 km/h, swept toward China Saturday after cutting power to thousands and forcing hundreds of flight cancellations in Taiwan and Japan's southernmost islands.

overnight_items.headline: WSJ: Xinjiang becomes showcase for China's commercial ambitions
overnight_items.body_text: The Wall Street Journal reports Xinjiang has become a centerpiece of Beijing's trade and energy ambitions even as the region remains a flashpoint for international human-rights controversy.

overnight_items.headline: Taiwan life expectancy rises to 81.27 years; cancer leading cause for 44th year
overnight_items.body_text: Taiwan's average life expectancy reached 81.27 years, up from 80.77 the prior year, the Interior Ministry said, with cancer accounting for 27.48 percent of all deaths and remaining the top cause for a 44th consecutive year.

overnight_items.headline: 1 million Hong Kong employees gain full MPF portability starting December
overnight_items.body_text: About 1 million Hong Kong employees will be able to move their entire Mandatory Provident Fund savings to a new provider once a year starting Dec. 21, the MPF Schemes Authority said, rolling out the change in two phases.

overnight_items.headline: China's first AI-generated feature film earns just RMB665,000 in two days
overnight_items.body_text: Sanxingdui: Future Past, China's first fully AI-generated theatrical film, grossed about RMB665,000 in its opening two days, far short of the roughly RMB35-55 million box office needed to recoup production costs, Hong Kong media reported.

overnight_items.headline: China launches six remote-sensing satellites on 673rd Long March flight
overnight_items.body_text: China launched six remote-sensing satellites aboard a Long March 4B rocket from Jiuquan early Saturday, the 673rd Long March flight, for use in land surveys, crop-yield estimation and disaster mitigation.

us_china.headline: MOFA protests US ban on DeepSeek for federal agencies as 'overstretching' security
us_china.body_text: The US Department of Homeland Security barred civilian agencies Monday from using DeepSeek-derived AI tools, warning they risk transferring sensitive data to China. MOFA spokesperson **Mao Ning** said China 'consistently opposed the overstretching of the concept of national security and the politicisation of issues related to science, technology, and trade.'

us_china.headline: US and China form competing AI blocs, squeezing third countries
us_china.body_text: AP reports Washington and Beijing are each building competing coalitions around AI standards and infrastructure, forcing other governments to navigate between the two technology ecosystems. The piece arrives as both capitals court partners ahead of the APEC summit China hosts in Shenzhen Nov. 18-19.

us_china.headline: China 'firmly opposes' new US Treasury proposal tightening outbound-investment review
us_china.body_text: **MOFCOM** said Saturday it firmly opposes a new US Treasury proposal expanding national-security review of outbound investment into China, calling it 'a typical case of overstretching the concept of national security.' The draft rule, published Thursday, adds biotechnology to restricted sectors and gives Treasury authority to designate additional industries.

us_china.headline: US presses Japan to align security revision with 'first island chain' strategy; lawmaker vows Taiwan arms-sale push
us_china.body_text: A US deputy secretary of state, identified in Chinese reports as Landau, told a Tokyo forum Saturday that Japan's security-strategy revision, due by year-end, must align with the US push to strengthen deterrence along the first island chain linking Japan, Taiwan and the Philippines. Rep. Ami Bera, co-chair of the House Taiwan Caucus, said he will press **Trump** to approve a pending Taiwan arms sale and intensify the effort if Democrats retake the House Nov. 3.

china_world.headline: TAO's Song Tao pledges support for Taiwan's 'pro-unification patriots' on Restoration Day
china_world.body_text: **Song Tao**, head of Beijing's Taiwan Affairs Office, pledged at a Fuzhou commemoration Sunday to support pro-unification forces in Taiwan as China marked the 81st anniversary of the end of Japanese colonial rule, formally designated 'Taiwan Restoration Day' last year. CCTV released Jilin-1 satellite imagery of Taipei landmarks, while the PLA's Eastern Theater Command issued a commemorative poster on the theme of national unity.

china_world.headline: Japan to ramp up security-policy PR campaign ahead of year-end strategy revision
china_world.body_text: Japan's government will intensify security-policy public-relations campaigns from late October, tailoring messaging by age group ahead of a planned revision of its '3 Security Documents' by year-end. The materials reference a 'new way of fighting' and 'sustained response capability' for prolonged conflict.

china_world.headline: Venezuela to restart crucial power plant with Chinese assistance
china_world.body_text: Bloomberg reports Venezuela plans to restart a crucial power plant with assistance from China, continuing Beijing's infrastructure engagement in a country largely cut off from Western financing. No financing or timeline details were disclosed.

china_world.headline: China, Kyrgyzstan convene sixth China-Central Asia think tank forum in Bishkek
china_world.body_text: The sixth China-Central Asia Think Tank Forum, themed 'high-quality development and common modernization,' met in Bishkek Oct. 22, co-hosted by the Chinese Academy of Social Sciences and a Kyrgyz presidential institute. CASS vice president **Li Xuesong** cited the China-Kyrgyzstan-Uzbekistan railway as a flagship project.

china_world.headline: ASEAN durian exporters meet 90-plus Chinese buyers at Kunming trade fair
china_world.body_text: More than 40 durian growers and exporters from Cambodia, Thailand, Vietnam and Malaysia met over 90 Chinese buyers, cold-chain operators and processors in Kunming Oct. 23 to negotiate supply deals. China remains the top destination market for Southeast Asian durian exports.

top_stories.headline: China's Communist Party completes provincial reshuffle ahead of Monday's Fifth Plenum
top_stories.body: Anhui, Henan, Shanxi and Xinjiang wrapped up provincial party congresses and installed new standing committees for the next five years in the week before the Fifth Plenum of the 20th Central Committee opens in Beijing Monday. The plenum is expected to finalize recommendations for the *15th Five-Year Plan* ahead of the 21st Party Congress in 2027.

top_stories.headline: China's $3.5 trillion stock rout turns cheap valuations into an earnings trap
top_stories.body: Bloomberg reports *$3.5 trillion* has been erased from Chinese equities as weak corporate earnings undercut the rally that drove this year's rebound, turning low valuations into a trap for investors betting on a turnaround. The Hang Seng fell 4.03% to 23,093.37 on Oct 23, while the Shanghai Composite slipped 1.08% to 3,690.47.

top_stories.headline: Taiwan's ITRI to build rare-earth plant to meet half of domestic demand by 2030
top_stories.body: Taiwan's Industrial Technology Research Institute plans a rare-earth demonstration plant producing *500 tonnes* annually, aiming to cover half the island's needs by the end of 2030, ITRI president **Chang Pei-zen** said. Construction is targeted for completion by 2028, with funding to be requested from the National Science and Technology Council and government price guarantees for investors still under discussion; Reuters separately reported TSMC is exploring alternatives to rare-earth components in factory equipment.

top_stories.headline: EU seizes record 196 million counterfeit goods in 2025, over 40% from China
top_stories.body: The EU Intellectual Property Office recorded *196 million* counterfeit goods seized across the bloc in 2025, a record, with China the largest single source country at more than 40 percent of seizures, followed by Turkey at over 18 percent. Seized-goods retail value topped €6.3 billion, up from under €3.9 billion in 2024, with Spain and Germany accounting for the largest shares by value.

also_today.headline: PBOC to issue 2027 Panda gold and silver coin set Oct. 30
also_today.body_text: The 15-coin set, minted in Shenyang, Shanghai and Shenzhen, depicts Beijing's Temple of Heaven and two pandas.

also_today.headline: Jiaolong submersible completes 7,057-meter dive after upgrade
also_today.body_text: China's Jiaolong submersible reached 7,056.9 meters in the Philippine Sea basin after an upgrade adding domestic lithium batteries and an AI-based seabed image system.

also_today.headline: Greek culture minister touts deepened China-Greece exchange after Liangzhu Forum
also_today.body_text: Lina Mendoni cited joint archaeology and a 2024 Chinese classical-civilization research institute in Athens ahead of the 55th anniversary of bilateral ties next year.

business_economy.headline: European luxury groups lose €250bn in value as Chinese demand fades
business_economy.body_text: FT reports European luxury groups have lost *€250 billion* in combined value as a China slowdown compounds cooling global equity markets, deepening a sector-wide downturn.

business_economy.headline: SoftBank-backed XAG pitches pilotless crop sprayers to Chinese farmers
business_economy.body_text: Chinese start-up XAG, backed by SoftBank, is marketing pilotless crop-spraying drones as a solution to a shrinking farm workforce and rising temperatures, FT reports.

business_economy.headline: China's first fully operational regional power market launches across five provinces
business_economy.body_text: The Southern Regional Electricity Market, covering Guangdong, Guangxi, Yunnan, Guizhou and Hainan, moved to full operation Oct. 24 under China Southern Power Grid, the country's first region-wide unified power market.

business_economy.headline: Japanese automakers race to halve vehicle development time to match Chinese rivals
business_economy.body_text: Toyota, Honda, Nissan, Suzuki and Mitsubishi are cutting new-car development cycles, currently four to five years, more than double China's pace, with Nissan targeting *3 years, 1 month* for a new SUV launching in North America in 2028, Kyodo reported.

business_economy.headline: Hong Kong held APEC talks on expanding yuan use in regional trade settlement
business_economy.body_text: Hong Kong's financial services and treasury chief **Christopher Hui** said the city discussed reducing US dollar reliance and expanding yuan and local-currency trade settlement with regional finance ministries at last week's APEC meeting.

business_economy.headline: Gold slide below $4,000/oz triggers crowds at Shenzhen's Shuibei jewelry market
business_economy.body_text: Spot gold fell 0.72% to $3,995.63 an ounce Friday, prompting Chow Tai Fook, Lao Feng Xiang and other Chinese retailers to cut gold-jewelry prices by RMB6-12 per gram; crowds packed Shenzhen's Shuibei market Saturday.

official_line.speaker: Mao Ning
official_line.topic: US DHS ban on DeepSeek AI tools for federal agencies
official_line.statement: China has consistently opposed the overstretching of the concept of national security and the politicisation of issues related to science, technology, and trade.
official_line.context: DHS barred civilian agencies from using DeepSeek-derived AI tools Monday, citing risk that user data could be transferred to China under PRC law.

official_line.speaker: MOFCOM spokesperson
official_line.topic: US Treasury proposal tightening outbound-investment review of China
official_line.statement: US restrictions on investment in China are not conducive to China-US economic and trade cooperation, and will also harm the interests of American enterprises themselves.
official_line.original_zh: 美方限制對華投資，既不利於中美經貿合作，也會損害美國企業自身利益
official_line.context: US Treasury published a draft rule last Thursday adding biotechnology to restricted outbound-investment sectors and empowering itself to designate further industries.

official_line.speaker: Xinhua commentary
official_line.topic: 81st anniversary of Taiwan's retrocession, cross-strait reunification
official_line.statement: The Taiwan question arose from national weakness and turmoil, and will inevitably be resolved along with national rejuvenation.
official_line.original_zh: 台湾问题因民族弱乱而产生，必将随着民族复兴而解决。
official_line.context: Published as China marked the 81st anniversary of Taiwan's 1945 retrocession and the first anniversary of the official 'Taiwan Restoration Day' memorial, coinciding with the 55th anniversary of UN Resolution 2758.
official_line.source: Xinhua commentary via China News Service

official_line.speaker: Xi Jinping
official_line.topic: 90th anniversary of the Long March; 'new Long March' framing ahead of Fifth Plenum
official_line.statement: The new journey is an expedition filled with glory and dreams; it is the new Long March of the Party and the people.
official_line.original_zh: 新征程是充满光荣和梦想的远征，是党和人民的新长征。
official_line.context: Remarks made at a Beijing commemoration of the 90th anniversary of the Red Army's Long March victory, cited in PLA Daily commentary published Sunday ahead of the Fifth Plenum.

official_line.speaker: Pan Gongsheng
official_line.topic: Policy rate benchmark shift to overnight repo rate
official_line.statement: Per Sina Finance: Pan Gongsheng said the PBOC is studying when to shift its primary open-market operation tenor to overnight, making the overnight repo rate the main policy rate, and is pushing loan-pricing benchmarks to diversify beyond the LPR.
official_line.context: The PBOC rolled over only CNY700 billion of a CNY900 billion maturing MLF tranche on Oct 26, a CNY200 billion net drain, its first operation since Pan's remarks on the rate-anchor shift.

social_statements.quote_text: The mainland's military and people resisted Japan, and Taiwan's people also resisted Japan; when the War of Resistance achieved victory, both sides of the strait celebrated together.
social_statements.analyst_note: Hung made the remarks at a symposium in Fuzhou marking the 81st anniversary of Taiwan's 1945 retrocession from Japan.

social_statements.quote_text: China is adopting a tougher posture toward Japan.
social_statements.analyst_note: Remarks made at the 13th 'Mt. Fuji Dialogue' in Tokyo, co-hosted by the Japan Center for Economic Research and the Japan Institute of International Affairs.

personnel_changes.position: Fujian Provincial Party Committee Deputy Secretary
personnel_changes.name: Lin Tao (林涛)
personnel_changes.detail: The CCP Central Committee approved Lin Tao as deputy secretary of the Fujian provincial party committee.

personnel_changes.name: Qin Haixiang (秦海翔)
personnel_changes.detail: Qin Haixiang was named a Fujian provincial standing committee member and Fuzhou party secretary.
